name: ourpr-mcp-server
description: Read your own ourpr running history in Claude.
long_description: Runs, mile splits, watch laps, streams, interval workouts and similar terrain, from your own ourpr account. Read only. The token comes from ourpr Settings and you can revoke it there at any time.

token.title: Access token
token.description: From ourpr: Settings, Access tokens, New token.

tools.name: ourpr_list_runs
tools.description: Your runs between two dates, as a table.

tools.name: ourpr_get_run
tools.description: One run in full, with its splits.

tools.name: ourpr_run_stream
tools.description: A run's elevation, heart rate, power and cadence, summarised.

tools.name: ourpr_rep_workouts
tools.description: Every interval workout in your history.

tools.name: ourpr_detect_reps
tools.description: Whether one run was an interval workout.

tools.name: ourpr_similar_terrain
tools.description: Runs that match a distance and a climb.
